messages:
alex: Starting a hotfix rollout for embeddings service — crash on long-prefix requests causing KV cache blowout. Root fix built in image gcr.io/redwood/embeddings@sha256:bf12c9. Need expedited deploy (staging -> canary -> prod) during the change window now. Requesting pin and quick canary.
deploybot: [deploy request received] env=prod service=embeddings image=gcr.io/redwood/embeddings@sha256:bf12c9 plan=staging->canary(5%)->100% if green. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/1764209876

marta: timeline?

alex: Aim to start staging in ~5m, canary at +5m after staging green, full roll in ~15m if no regressions.

priya: Oncall here — +1 for expedited. I will monitor logs & latency. Will check slow-request samples at T+5m.

leo: Please pin the image digest in the k8s manifest before handoff. Command to use:
```sh
kubectl set image deploy/embeddings embeddings=gcr.io/redwood/embeddings@sha256:bf12c9 -n prod
```
Do not rotate backends during canary.

jamie: Release note added with customer-impact blurb and rollback instructions: https://docs.redwood/release-notes/1764209876

ops-bot: Alert channel reserved: #incidents auto-snooze=300s for deploy window. Pager escalation unchanged.

alex: Dev/unit/load tests passed locally. Artifact size +1.2%. Ready to proceed.

marta: +1 :thumbsup: (ops signoff)

priya: +1 (oncall) — will confirm telemetry at each stage.
deploybot: Starting staging rollout now — job=82723. Live logs: https://deploys.redwood/jobs/82723

deploybot: Staging health checks passed (3/3) — promoting to canary 5%.

deploybot: Canary 5% complete, no 5xx spikes, P95 stable. Proceeding to 50%.

leo: Telemetry shows KV eviction rates back to baseline and memory stable across pods.

deploybot: Rollout to 50% complete; initiating final ramp to 100%.

deploybot: Rollout to 100% complete. All pods on image bf12c9. No new alerts in the 10m post-merge window.

alex: Good job. Pin documented in CHANGELOG and internal ops playbook. Tagged hotfix: hotfix/embeddings/bf12c9

marta: Thanks team — closing thread. If anything pops, ping #oncall immediately.

deploybot: Deploy job 82723 closed: success
